calls.reason: Stanford HAI counts 123 AI-related bills since 2016, and China's 2023 generative-AI rules exist, but nothing in the packet counts all laws in force. So the proportions claimed cannot be judged from this evidence.

Menlo puts 2023 enterprise generative-AI spending at $2.5B, and Reuters shows OpenAI at $28M in 2022 and about $80M a month in 2023. Together these point to low billions so far, a tiny share of the economy.

Google's November 2023 policy agenda explicitly called for regulating AI with substantive rules. The DIGITALEUROPE statement sought to limit foundation-model duties to transparency, not to exempt generative AI from all regulation.
